title: Medição — Yahoo intraday para `.SA` (Fase 1 do CHECKOUT Intraday/Trailing/Web)
summary: Empirical measurement of Yahoo Finance intraday API limits, latency, and B3 coverage to inform an upcoming ADR on the Radar's intraday data source.
scope: pending ADR on intraday data source
notes: No Status/Decision/Consequences sections, no user stories, no system-owned API contract — this is an empirical benchmark/research doc about a third-party API (Yahoo), explicitly framed as input to a not-yet-written ADR (section 9: 'O que ainda falta antes do ADR'). Classified DOC over SPEC because it documents observed behavior of an external service rather than defining a contract this system must implement; flagging medium confidence since its data-heavy, decision-adjacent content borders SPEC/pre-ADR territory and the synthesizer may want to treat it as context feeding a future ADR rather than a locked decision or requirement.
